verdict.rationale: Hightouch's composable architecture runs on the customer's own warehouse, and collected events are written there, so customer data is not copied into a separate system. A community report says no data is stored in Hightouch out of the box and that everything stays in the customer's warehouse or S3 bucket. In effect, residency follows wherever the customer hosts its warehouse, which is indirect control rather than an explicit region choice. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for the Hightouch workspace or control plane, documented data-residency options (e.g., EU/US hosting), and first-party docs on where metadata and processing occur.
